The '''UR-1060 system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[UR-1060/Legends|UR-1060]].
